_comment: Per-lesson visual-novel presentation for curriculum lessons: which coworker, which scene, and the NPC's opening line. Curriculum content stays pure; this is the only place scene/character/opening is decided, and it is data, not code. Any lesson id missing here falls back to computed defaults in curriculum.ts.
